slow.description: Sluggish network: 2-5s latency on every API call

outage.description: Server down: every API endpoint returns 503

partial-outage.description: Grades and teammates endpoints down (other endpoints still work)

auth.description: Require an Authorization header on every API call

corrupt.description: Truncate every successful response body in half

timeout-grades.description: Grade endpoints hang for 30s before returning 504

chaos.description: Everything is broken: latency, errors, and corrupted bodies
